__doc__: sim-realtime-factor-v1: opt-out speed fragment to MERGE into a mission runtime-config (e.g. the cold-cycle config), making a full 7-stage run >=2x faster in WALL time with no stage-result change and the same recording-camera video. Absent keys => byte-identical to today's run. Three levers. (1) sim_speed:max (twin.restock.sim_speed, from the earlier sim-video-speedup-v1): pauses the station decode cameras in the nav stages AND -- new this task -- in GROUND-TRUTH collect (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1 env), where no station camera is read yet all three 2560x1920 decode cameras used to render on every walkthrough frame (~40% of a cold run's wall). The on-demand resume is the safety net: a wrong 'unread' guess costs one tick, never the run. (2) physics_dt (twin.restock.physics_step): raise the physics step 1/60 -> 1/36 so the same simulated span runs ~0.60x the ticks (the plain-tick floor of 40-53 ms/tick is the hard wall cost). Threaded into World(physics_dt=,rendering_dt=) AND the mission loop tick(dt)/BT run_mission_tree(dt=) from THIS key; IsaacPort.advance asserts world.get_physics_dt()==dt so a mis-thread fails the boot. Every mission guard is sim-clocked (elapsed += dt vs a sim budget) so a coarser step changes no decision; the contact-tolerance CHECK (physics_step.max_safe_physics_dt) binds on the 3 mm grasp-weld window at dt<=1/33 (weld step 1.39 mm < half-window at 1/36), with the 0.556 m/s tow step 15.4 mm < the ~20 mm PhysX contact offset. Fallback {"hz": 40} (x1.95, more margin); {"hz": 30} (x2.61) only if the GPU confirm is clean. (3) OPTIONAL trace_hz inside sim_speed (NOT in the profile): bound nav-trace.jsonl to N Hz of sim time -- add it only when the run does not need the per-tick trace (offline graders like check_tow_traction --gpu-run single-tick-stop read every tick). mission.json records physics_dt_mode=raised + sim_speed_mode=max. ACCEPTANCE (one GPU confirm run): >=2x wall vs the matched coldwin22 baseline (~x2.17 at 1/36), SAME stage verdicts incl. a welded grasp and a completed coupled tow, SAME 960x720 recording video. The TICK_PROFILE lines (on in max) give the measured per-stage ratio. Write-up: ~/firstmate/data/sim-realtime-factor-v1/report.md.
